```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(CLAMPData)
library(ExperimentHub)
```

# Introduction

This vignette demonstrates how to access data resources provided by **CLAMPData** through the [ExperimentHub](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/ExperimentHub.html) interface.  
If resources are not yet registered (e.g., before public upload), the code will safely skip and print informative messages.

# Listing resources

```{r list, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Initialize ExperimentHub
eh <- ExperimentHub::ExperimentHub()

# Try listing available resources for this package
resources <- tryCatch(
  ExperimentHub::listResources(eh, package = "CLAMPData"),
  error = function(e) {
    message("ExperimentHub resources not yet available (likely pre-publication).")
    return(NULL)
  }
)

if (!is.null(resources)) {
  resources
} else {
  cat("No registered resources yet. This vignette was likely built before data upload.\n")
}
```

# Accessing data files

```{r accessors, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Safely try to access resources (works after ExperimentHub upload)
if (exists("GSE164416_DP_htseq_counts_txt_gz", where = "package:CLAMPData")) {
  p_counts <- try(GSE164416_DP_htseq_counts_txt_gz(), silent = TRUE)
  p_h5     <- try(human_gene_v2_5_alz_h5(), silent = TRUE)
  p_meta   <- try(islets_metadata_csv(), silent = TRUE)

  if (!inherits(p_counts, "try-error")) {
    c(p_counts, p_h5, p_meta)
  } else {
    cat("Accessors not yet functional — package likely built before data registration.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Accessors not yet available in this build.\n")
}
```

# Reading example data

```{r read, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Example of how data will be read once published
if (exists("p_counts") && !inherits(p_counts, "try-error")) {
  # counts
  readLines(gzfile(p_counts), n = 5)

  # HDF5
  if (requireNamespace("rhdf5", quietly = TRUE))
    rhdf5::h5ls(p_h5)

  # metadata CSV
  head(read.csv(p_meta, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
} else {
  cat("Example file reading skipped (resources not yet available).\n")
}
```
